units.title: Linkspan
units.text: An adjustable bridge that connects the shore ramp to a ferry so vehicles can drive between the terminal and the vessel despite changes in tide level.

units.title: Dangerous-goods check
units.text: Vehicles carrying declared dangerous goods are held in the marked inspection bay until a terminal safety officer verifies the declaration and loading position.

units.title: Final passenger call
units.text: The gate agent makes the final passenger announcement ten minutes before the gangway closes. Missing passengers are removed from the boarded manifest before sailing.

units.title: Vehicle boarding stops in severe crosswind
units.text: Vehicle boarding stops when the crosswind alarm remains above the terminal limit. The exposed linkspan can move laterally, so continuing vehicle traffic would be unsafe.

units.title: Assisted boarding
units.text: Passengers who request mobility assistance report to the service desk. A passenger assistant escorts them through the accessible route and onto the vessel before general foot-passenger boarding.
